<thought>We need the retrosynthetic template that matches the carbonyl‑ene transformation described. By searching the template catalog with the broken and formed functional groups we can retrieve the appropriate template and then apply it to the target molecule to get all possible precursor sets.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone", "C=C"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["hydroxyl", "five-membered ring"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C=O", "C=C"],
    "bonds_order_changed": ["C=O (2.0->1.0)", "C=C (2.0->1.0)"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
